status: FROZEN_SPEC_ONLY — not enumerated, no Y access, no results
question: How does the T5 opening hour form at 15-minute resolution?
not_the_question: Repeat the 1H sequence miner four times finer.
rationale: The 1H work localized the signal: 1H T5 at h1 is +0.21..+0.31 against control while h2..h7 sit within +-0.009. A full-day 15m window would instead saturate — 26 bars give 25 adjacencies, and episode-level "ever occurred" membership explodes: a claim at 28% prevalence on 1H reaches ~75% at 15m, which stops being a sequence question and becomes a marginal-token one. k would grow while the number of distinct ideas would not.

window.requirement: complete opening hour required; incomplete -> excluded with a reason

position_anchoring_note: Sequences are ANCHORED to their position, so M1->M2 and M2->M3 are different claims. This is required by the question — "does the reversal happen in the first quarter-hour or the second" is unanswerable with position-agnostic membership. Consequence, declared now: the syntactic space is ~3x the position-agnostic one for 2-bar and ~2x for 3-bar.

support.note: identical to SEQUENCE_GRAMMAR_V1/ESTIMAND_V1 and fixed BEFORE enumeration

estimand.block: exact T5 date x pre-window liquidity LOW/HIGH x pre-window volatility LOW/HIGH
estimand.anchor: T5-2 session close (20-session median dollar volume; ATR14/close)
estimand.null: Y permutation within registered blocks, one map across all claims

multiplicity.may_not: upgrade or confirm any 1H claim; a 15m result cannot change a 1H verdict
multiplicity.ledger: both exposures are recorded; k is accounted per family, not pooled, ONLY because the decision rule is declared per family in advance rather than "take whichever search looks best"

forbidden_pattern: Taking the 1H winner and then searching 15m variants around it. That is post-selection refinement, not confirmation, and this spec exists precisely so the 15m design predates knowledge of the 1H outcome.
y_exposure: FORBIDDEN until the 1H primary result is sealed
